name: top-directional-drawer
blurb: Full-width drawer slides down from top with drag-to-close handle.
description: A Vaul-based drawer that slides from the top, responsive from 90% height on mobile to 450px on desktop. Shows drag handle on mobile, close button on desktop. Overlay backdrop with blur. Supports contextual actions like file upload and form submission.
use_when: You need a top-aligned drawer for actions or content that should appear above the fold.
avoid_when: Very tall content — the fixed 450px height may require scrolling.
a11y: Escape closes. Overlay click closes. Gesture support on mobile. Close button with icon only on desktop.
